messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
97 そして彼女は極めて悪質で邪悪な性質を持っている、 98 それは決して欲深い欲望を満たさない、 99 そして食事の後は、食べる前よりもむしろ飢えている。

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Japanese) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | e (97) | clause‑linking conjunction “and” | そして | “and” | OK | | ha (97) | main verb “has” (possession) | 持っている | “has / possesses” | OK | | natura | noun “nature” (inherent disposition) | 性質 | “nature” | OK | | sì | degree adverb “so” (intensifier) | 極めて | “extremely / so” | OK | | malvagia | adjective “malign” | 悪質で | “malign (and …)” | OK | | e (97‑2) | coordinating conjunction linking adjectives | で | “and / with” (conjunctive particle) | OK | | ria | adjective “evil” | 邪悪な | “evil” | OK | | che (98) | relative pronoun “that” introducing clause | それは | “that” (topic) | OK | | mai | negative adverb “never” | 決して | “never” | OK | | non | negative particle (part of double‑negative) | — (negation expressed in the verb) | “not” (implicit in 満たさない) | UNNECESSARY | | empie | verb “fills / satisfies” (negated by mai non) | 満たさない | “does not satisfy” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | — (articles omitted in Japanese) | — | UNNECESSARY | | bramosa | adjective “greedy” qualifying desire | 欲深い | “greedy” | OK | | voglia | noun “will / desire” | 欲望 | “desire / will” | OK | | e (99‑1) | clause‑linking conjunction “and” | そして | “and” | OK | | dopo | preposition “after” (temporal) | 後は | “after (topic)” | OK | | ’l | elided definite article “the” | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | pasto | noun “meal / food” | 食事 | “meal / food” | OK | | ha (99‑2) | auxiliary verb “has” (state) | 飢えている | “is hungry” (state) | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | よりも | “than” (comparative marker) | OK | | fame | noun “hunger” (state) | 飢えている | “is hungry” (state) | OK | | che (99‑2) | comparative conjunction “than” | よりも | “than” | OK | | pria | adverb “before” (temporal) | 食べる前 | “before eating” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **non** – Japanese does not have a separate particle for this; negation is built into the verb *満たさない*. Marked **UNNECESSARY**. - **la** – Definite article omitted in Japanese. **UNNECESSARY**. - **’l** – Definite article omitted. **UNNECESSARY**.
All other source words are adequately rendered in the Japanese translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 97: - Original: そして彼女は極めて悪質で邪悪な性質を持っている、 - Issue: none - Corrected: そして彼女は極めて悪質で邪悪な性質を持っている、
- Line 98: - Original: それは決して欲深い欲望を満たさない、 - Issue: none - Corrected: それは決して欲深い欲望を満たさない、
- Line 99: - Original: そして食事の後は、食べる前よりもむしろ飢えている。 - Issue: added unnecessary nuance 「むしろ」 - Corrected: そして食事の後は、食べる前よりも飢えている。
``` そして彼女は極めて悪質で邪悪な性質を持っている、 それは決して欲深い欲望を満たさない、 そして食事の後は、食べる前よりも飢えている。 ```
